items.text: Microsoft and Walgreens, America’s second largest pharmacy store chain, are working together for the next seven years to create initiatives in digital health care. The hope is to use Microsoft’s technology to improve health care in Walgreens’ stores and to lower the costs. Walgreens will test twelve ‘digital health corners’ that will sell devices for health care and Microsoft will be Walgreens’ online services provider. The other part of the project is to lower Amazon’s influence in health by providing more options. Last year, Amazon acquired an online pharmacy called Pill Pack as it moves into the prescription drug market. Pharmacy CVS responded by acquiring health insurance company Aetna, and both CVS and Walgreens then launched next-day prescription delivery services. Difficult words: initiative (a new and exciting project), acquire (buy and add onto an already existing company), launch (start). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Microsoft and a large pharmacy chain are working together for the next seven years to create new projects in health care. They want to use Microsoft’s technology to make health care in the pharmacy shops better and to lower costs. The other part of the project is to lower Amazon’s influence in health by giving people more options. Last year, Amazon bought an online pharmacy. Another pharmacy chain responded by buying a health insurance company. Then, both pharmacy chains started next-day delivery services for drugs. Difficult words: pharmacy (a place where you can get drugs and other things for your health care), chain (a group of shops by the same company), influence (how much power something or someone has). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Microsoft and a large pharmacy chain are working together in the USA. They want to work together for seven years. They want to make new projects in health care . They want to use Microsoft’s technology. It can help people’s health care in the pharmacy shops. It can make things cheaper too. They also want to stop Amazon from having too much power in health care. Difficult words: pharmacy (a place where you can get drugs and other things for your health), chain (a group of shops by the same company), health care (how you take care of yourself and your mind and body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Hundreds of bishops came together for a seven-day retreat near Chicago to reflect on sexual abuse scandals in the church. The retreat is yet another move by the Catholic Church to respond to the ongoing clergy sexual abuse scandal which has defamed the institution. Last month, Pope Francis decided to remove two cardinals from his group of advisers who are facing allegations related to the scandal. Pope Francis is also scheduled to meet with bishops from around the world next month to discuss preventing clergy sexual abuse. Difficult words: retreat (a quiet place, typically in the country, to talk and figure out problems), defame (damage a reputation), allegation (when somebody says that you did something illegal, it is an allegation because we do not know if it is true). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Hundreds of bishops came together for a seven-day meeting near Chicago. They said that they were there to reflect on sexual abuse scandals in the church . This is another move by the Catholic Church to respond to the sexual abuse scandals. Somebody said that the two cardinals abused someone – Pope Francis removed them from his group of advisors . Pope Francis is also going to meet bishops from around the world next month. They will discuss how to stop sex abuse. Difficult words: abuse (when you abuse somebody, you hurt him or her), church (an important and old organisation also called an institution), advisor (somebody who advises – who says what to do to help another person). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Catholic Church is infamous for sex abuse scandals. The institution is trying to make things better. Hundreds of bishops meet in the USA. They spend seven days together. They talk about the sex scandals. Pope Francis also tries to make things better. He fires two cardinals because they are in trouble. He plans to talk to bishops from around the world. He wants to stop the sex abuse. Difficult words: church (an old and important religious organisation, also called an institution), infamous (known for something bad), abuse (when you abuse somebody, you do something to them which they do not want to do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Joaquín Guzmán Loera, better known as El Chapo, ran Mexico’s Sinaloa cartel from 1989 to 2014. During that time, the cartel allegedly imported more than 200 metric tons of cocaine to the US along with heroin, methamphetamine and marijuana. In 2017, El Chapo was extradited to the USA and he has been on trial since November. If he is found guilty, he will spend the rest of his life in prison. El Chapo’s business partner told a New York court room last Tuesday that El Chapo bribed the now-former Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto. He said that the former president originally asked for $250 million from El Chapo, but they allegedly settled on $100 million, which he then paid to the then-president-elect in 2012. Enrique Peña Nieto stopped being president just last year, in 2018. His spokesman said that he didn’t take the bribe. Difficult words: allegedly (according to what some people say; it may or may not be true), extradite (hand over a criminal to a foreign country where he or she did something illegal), bribe (give money to somebody to do what you want them to do). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Joaquín Guzmán Loera, better known as El Chapo, ran Mexico’s Sinaloa cartel from 1989 to 2014. People say that in those 25 years, the cartel imported more than 200 metric tons of drugs into the USA. In 2017, El Chapo was moved to the USA where he is on trial . If he is found guilty, he will spend the rest of his life in prison. El Chapo’s business partner was in a New York court room last Tuesday. He said that El Chapo bribed the now- former Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto. It was a bribe of $100 million given to Nieto in 2012 when he was still running for president. Enrique Peña Nieto stopped being president just last year, in 2018. His spokesman said that he did not take the bribe. Difficult words: on trial (lawyers are working to say if he is guilty or not), bribe (give money to somebody to do what you want them to do), former (-ex). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Sinaloa cartel is a drug cartel in Mexico. Between 1989 and 2014, the cartel moves 200 tons of drugs to the USA. Joaquín Guzmán Loera was the boss of the cartel. People also call him El Chapo. He is in the USA now. He can go to prison for life. His ex-assistant talks at a court in New York. He says that El Chapo gave $100 million to Enrique Peña Nieto in 2012. Enrique Peña Nieto was the Mexican President until 2018. Difficult words: cartel (a big criminal organisation), court (a room with lawyers who say if somebody goes to prison or not), gave (past of ‘give’). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

According to a new report, ocean temperatures in 2018 were the hottest that they have been since the record keeping began in 1958. The authors of the report say that ocean heating is solid proof of climate change, and that the findings are a ‘ major concern ’ for both the scientific and global communities. The scientists are the same group of researchers who published a report last week showing that the world’s oceans are heating up faster than people previously thought. Warmer oceans can cause a number of issues , such as rising sea levels, heavier rainfall, stronger storms, and melting polar ice. In fact, another study found that Antarctica’s ice sheet has been melting over the past four decades at an alarming rate. Difficult words: major concern (a big problem), issue (a problem), sheet (ice which covers a large area of land). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 1958, people began recording ocean temperatures. According to a new report , ocean temperatures in 2018 were the hottest ever. The authors of the report say that this is solid proof of climate change. They say that this is a big problem for everybody. The authors are the same scientists who also published another report last week. It says that oceans are getting warmer faster than people thought. This can lead to problems like rising sea levels, heavier rainfall, stronger storms, and melting polar ice. Difficult words: report (an official document about something), solid (strong), proof (evidence, a thing which shows that something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 1958, people start to record ocean temperatures. In 2018, the oceans are the hottest ever. This is written in a report . The authors of the report say that this is proof of climate change. They say that this is a big problem. They also say that the oceans are getting warmer very fast. Sea water can go up. There can be strong storms. There can be heavy rains. Difficult words: record (measure and write down), report (an official document about something), proof (evidence, a thing which shows that something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

An American judge ruled that even with a warrant , the police cannot force people to unlock their devices with their fingers, eyes or face. The judge likened the biometrics to a numeric passcode – something which people do not have to reveal under the American Fifth Amendment (an article added to the US Constitution) which is protection against self-incrimination . Difficult words: warrant (a legal document which lets police arrest somebody, or search a place), device (electronic objects like smartphones, tablets or computers), the biometrics (a way of unlocking your device with a part of your body), self-incrimination (making yourself appear guilty of a crime). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

An American judge ruled that the police cannot force people to unlock their devices with their fingers, eyes or face. The judge said that the biometric protection was like a numeric passcode – something the people do not have to share if they do not want to. Difficult words: force (make), device (an electronic thing like a smartphone, a tablet, or a computer), biometric (using a part of your body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people have smartphones or tablets. You can unlock many smartphones with your finger, your eyes or your face. This news is about the American police. A judge rules that police cannot make people unlock their phones with their finger, eyes, or face. People can unlock the device only if they want to. Difficult words: unlock (open), judge (a lawyer with a lot of power and authority), rule (officially say what people can or cannot do), device (an electronic thing like a smartphone, a tablet, or a computer). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Hasan Minhaj is an American comedian who ‘explores the larger trends shaping our fragmented world’ in his show ‘Patriot Act’ which is available on Netflix (an online video streaming service). There is an episode in which he talks about Saudi Arabia. In it, he criticises the Saudi leader, Prince Salman, and he says that it is possible that Prince Salman was involved in the killing of a journalist named Jamal Khashoggi. He goes on to say that Prince Salman is not modernising Saudi Arabia, and he is only modernising the Saudi dictatorship. Netflix removed the episode in Saudi Arabia after it received a ‘valid legal request’. Saudi Arabia’s cybercrime law prohibits the production, preparation, transmission, or storage of a material impinging on public order, religious values, public morals, and privacy’ on the Internet. This crime is punishable by up to five years in prison and a fine of up to $800,000. You can still watch the full episode outside of Saudi Arabia, and parts of it are available on the ‘Patriot Act’ YouTube channel. Minhaj said that banning the episode meant that it became a trend online, so now it is possible that more people know about it and are going to watch it on YouTube. Difficult words: fragmented (broken into parts), involved (playing some part in something), impinge (have a negative effect). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Netflix is an online service where you can watch TV series, shows and films. ‘Patriot Act’ is a show about serious things, but people present them in a comedic way. One episode is about Saudi Arabia. In it, the host criticises the Saudi leader, Prince Salman, and says that it is possible the prince was involved in the killing of a journalist. The host also says that Prince Salman is not modernising Saudi Arabia, and he is only modernising the Saudi dictatorship. Saudi Arabia has laws which ban videos that can have a bad effect on public order or public morals. The Saudi government asked Netflix to remove the episode and Netflix removed it. Breaking the laws can mean up to five years in prison or a fine of up to $800,000. However, you can still see the full episode outside of Saudi Arabia, and parts of it are available on the ‘Patriot Act’ YouTube channel. Difficult words: host (the person who leads and talks in a TV show), involved (that he had something to do with the killing), ban (make illegal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Netflix is an online service. You can watch TV series, shows and films on your tablet or computer. ‘Patriot Act’ is one of the shows that you can watch. The show is about serious things. However, the host talks about these things in a funny way. In one episode , he talks about Saudi Arabia. He talks about the Saudi leader, Prince Salman. The host criticises Prince Salman. He says that Prince Salman is not making the country better. The Saudi government does not like the episode. It tells Netflix to take it down. Netflix takes it down. You cannot watch the episode in Saudi Arabia. Difficult words: host (the person who leads and talks in a TV show), episode (one ‘film’ or ‘story’ of a TV show), government (the ‘bosses’ of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The United Nations is an international organisation which aims to promote peace, security and cooperation, and seventeen per cent of the staff there completed an online survey about their experience with sexual harassment at the bloc . From the surveyed 30,000 people, 10,000 of them experienced sexual harassment at the bloc in the last two years, and more than a half of the harassed experienced it in an office setting. Difficult words: staff (the employees – the people who work somewhere), promote (support), bloc (an organisation of countries). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The United Nations is an international organisation. It says that it promotes positive things like peace and security. However, 17 per cent of the UN employees (30,000 people) took an online survey about sexual harassment . A third of those people (10,000 people) said that they were sexually harassed in the past two years. More than a half of the harassed people were harassed at the work place. Difficult words: promote (support, do something so that there is more of it), employee (worker), survey (a set of questions to find out what people think), sexual harassment (the act of harassing somebody sexually – doing something sexual that they do not like). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The United Nations is an international organisation. It says that it promotes good things like peace and security. However, there are problems at the organisation. Seventeen per cent of UN workers take a survey . It is about sexual harassment . Seventeen per cent of the workers is 30,000 people. A third of those people (10,000 people) say that they were harassed in the last two years. Difficult words: promote (do something so that there is more of it), survey (a set of questions to find out what people think), sexual harassment (the act of harassing somebody sexually – doing something sexual that they do not like), were (past of ‘are’). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Since the Democratic Republic of the Congo became independent, it has never had a peaceful transition of power. People are afraid that there could be violence as the presidential election recently took place. Election officials are waiting to release the results, which worries people that there has been a manipulation of the votes. However, the leader of the election commission said that the large size of the country made it impossible to release the votes on time. People in the opposition do not believe this claim and feel that the votes will be manipulated to favour the person that the current president wants to come after him. Despite that people do know who the winner is, all three of the presidential candidates are saying that they won. Difficult words: violence (fighting), election (electing – voting/choosing the leader), election commission (the people in charge of the elections). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Democratic Republic of the Congo never had a peaceful transition of power . When a new person becomes the leader, people start fighting. Voting for a new president just happened and people are worried. The election officials do not want to release the presidential election results, which is not good. Some people think that the votes will be manipulated, so that the candidate which the current president wants to become the next president can win. We do not know the winner of the election, but all three of the presidential candidates are saying that they won. Difficult words: a peaceful transition of power (when a leader peacefully stops being a leader for the next leader to take over), election (electing – voting/choosing the leader), release (show officially). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Congo is a country in the centre of Africa. When there is a new leader, there is always fighting and trouble. There is an election . People elect the new president. However, the election officials do not want to show the winner. People are afraid that someone is changing their votes . We do not know who wins. However, all three candidates are saying that they won . Difficult words: election (electing – voting/choosing the leader), election officials (the people who organise and run the election), vote (a vote shows who one person wants as the next president), won (past of ‘win’). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US partial government shutdown started on December 22, 2018, and as of Sunday, it has gone 22 days, making it the longest funding gap ever. Previously, the longest US shutdown was 21 days. President Trump and the Democrats are stuck over building a wall between the US and Mexico. President Trump wants $5.7 billion so people can build over 200 miles of a wall or a fence between the two countries. The Democrats disagree and think that money for a wall will not fix the issues at the border with one saying that there are other ways to make the border safer. The lengthy government shutdown means that around 800,000 government workers are furloughed or are working without pay while the disagreement continues. Difficult words: government shutdown (when non-essential offices of the government close because leaders cannot agree on the budget for the country for the upcoming year), funding gap (when things are not paid for a long time), furlough (when someone cannot go to work because he or she will not be paid). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US partial government shutdown has gone 22 days, making it the longest shutdown ever. Previously, the longest US shutdown was 21 days. President Trump and the Democrats are stuck overbuilding a wall between the US and Mexico. President Trump wants $5.7 billion to build over 200 miles of a wall or a fence. The Democrats think that money for a wall will not fix the border problems. One Democrat said that there were other ways to make the border safer. The long government shutdown means that around 800,000 government workers are furloughed or are working without pay. Difficult words: government shutdown (when less important parts of the government close because leaders cannot agree on the budget for the country for the upcoming year), furlough (when someone cannot go to work because the work is shutdown). )You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US partial government shutdown is 22 days long. It is the longest shutdown ever. The longest US shutdown was 21 days. President Trump and the Democrats see things differently. President Trump wants $5.7 billion to build a very long wall between the US and Mexico. The Democrats think that a wall will not fix the border problems. One Democrat says that there are other ways to fix the problems. The long government shutdown changes jobs for 800,000 government workers. Some cannot work. Some are working without pay. Difficult words: partial (not complete), government shutdown (when some parts of the government close because the leaders cannot agree on how to spend money), Democrats (a political party in the United States that feels different than the President Donald Trump), border (the line between countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Rahaf Mohammed Alqunun is an 18-year-old woman from Saudi Arabia who says that her family tried to forcefully marry her off and has been abusive to her – especially after she renounced Islam. When she was on vacation with her family in Kuwait, she ran away, got on a plane to Thailand and planned to go to Australia to ask for asylum . However, when she reached Bangkok, Thai officials stopped her and took her passport away. She was facing deportation to Saudi Arabia, so she barricaded herself in a Thai airport hotel room and asked for help on social media. She said that going back to Saudi Arabia would mean abuse by her family or even being sent to jail. In response to the events, the UN granted her refugee status, which means that she can enjoy certain rights and protections, which people agreed in the 1951 Refugee convention. Difficult words: abusive (hurting someone physically or psychologically), renounce (say that you do not believe in something), ask for asylum (ask if you can live somewhere in safety), barricade (block oneself into somewhere), deportation (transport a foreigner from a country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Rahaf Mohammed Alqunun is an 18-year-old woman from Saudi Arabia. She says that her family abuses her, especially after she renounced Islam. Her family and she went on holiday to Kuwait where she ran away. She got on a plane to Thailand and planned to go to Australia to ask for asylum . However, Thai officials stopped her and took her passport away. She was afraid that Thailand would send her back to Saudi Arabia to her abusive family. She locked herself up in a Thai airport hotel room and asked people for help on social media. The UN reacted to her situation and gave her refugee status. This gives her some protection. Difficult words: abuse (hurt somebody physically or psychologically), renounce (say that you do not believe in something), ask for asylum (ask if you can live somewhere else in safety). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This is a story about a woman from Saudi Arabia. She is 18 years old. She says that her family abuses her. She and her family go on holiday to Kuwait. She runs away from her family there. She flies to Thailand. From Thailand, she plans to go to Australia. She wants to ask for asylum . However, the Thai police stop her. They take her passport away. She is in a hotel room. She is afraid that Thailand wants to send her back to Saudi Arabia. Things are bad for her there. She asks people on the Internet for help. The UN sees her situation. The UN gives her refugee status. This means that she has some protection. Difficult words: abuse (hurt, be very bad to), ask for asylum (ask if you can live somewhere in safety), refugee (a person who is running away from his or her country because he or she is not safe there). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

More than 71 people are dead, 17 missing, and more than 40,000 were displaced after a massive storm struck the Philippines. One of the country’s officials said that the storm was not strong enough to be rated as a typhoon, so many people were unprepared. Dozens of them died in landslides and flooding caused by the heavy rains. The country already suffered a number of deadly storms recently – Super Typhoon Mangkhut killed more than 80 people in September and Typhoon Yutu killed 17 more. Difficult words: displace (force to leave home), official (an officer, an administrator), dozens (more than 12 but less than 100). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A massive storm struck the Philippines. The storm was not strong enough to be called a typhoon, so many people were unprepared. Seventy-one people died, 17 people are missing, and more than 40,000 people were displaced . Many people died in landslides and flooding . This storm is not the first to hit the Philippines recently. Super Typhoon Mangkhut killed more than 80 people in September, and Typhoon Yutu killed 17 people. Difficult words: strike (hit), displace (make leave home), flooding (big water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A storm hits the Philippines. It is not strong enough to be called a typhoon. Many people do not get ready for the storm because of this. However, the storm is big. Seventy-one people die in the storm. Seventeen people are missing . More than 40,000 people are displaced . This storm is one of a few storms to hit the Philippines recently . Before this storm, there is Super Typhoon Mangkhut. It kills 80 people. Typhoon Yutu kills 17 people. Difficult words: be missing (if somebody is missing, we do not know if he or she is OK and where he or she is), displace (leave home because of danger), recently (in the last few months, not long ago). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

During Bangladesh’s national election on Sunday, December 30th, the country’s Prime Minister, Sheikh Hasina, and her party secured their third straight term. The ruling Awami League party scored nearly all of 300 parliamentary seats – only a few were lost to the opposing Bangladesh Nationalist Party. The losing party denounced the election results, accusing the winners of rigging the vote. The prime minister denied the claims and said that there would not be a new vote. During the election, there were violent fights between the supporters of the ruling and opposition parties. At least 17 people died during the vote. Difficult words: secure (know your position in something), denounce (say that you do not respect the result of something), accuse (say that somebody did something illegal), rig (manipulate, control, fake), deny (say that something is not true). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

An election happened on Sunday, December 30th in Bangladesh. The country’s Prime Minister, Sheikh Hasina, and her party won for the third time. The losing party denounced the result of the election and said that the election was rigged . The prime minister said that this was not true. There were fights in the streets during the election. People who liked one party fought people who liked the other party. At least 17 people died. Difficult words: election (when people elect/vote/choose the bosses of their country), denounce (say that you do not respect the result of something), rig (manipulate, control, fake). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

An election happens in Bangladesh. Sheikh Hasina and her party win. They win for the third time. The losers of the election say that the election is rigged . They do not respect that they lost. The prime minister says that the election is not rigged. Some people fight in the streets. People who like one party fight people who like the other party. At least 17 people die. Difficult words: election (when people elect/vote/choose the bosses of their country), party (a group of people in politics), rig (manipulate, control, fake). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

According to a report released by the Aviation Safety Network, the number of people killed in airplane crashes shot up significantly in 2018. A total of 556 people died in 15 airliner accidents worldwide last year which is a big jump, which only saw 10 accidents and 44 deaths in 2017. However, 2018 was still one of the safest years on record – 2017 was the safest year ever. Experts say that aviation safety continues getting better overall. The document states that “loss of control” accidents have been a major safety concern over the last five years and caused at least 10 of the 25 worst accidents. Difficult words: aviation (flying), significantly (greatly), on record (officially measured and noted), major (main, the biggest). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A report shows that the number of people killed in airplane crashes went up significantly in 2018. A total of 556 people died in 15 airliner accidents worldwide last year. That is a big jump compared to 2017, which only saw 10 accidents and 44 deaths. However, 2018 was still one of the safest years– 2017 was the safest year ever. Experts say that aviation safety continues getting better overall. Difficult words: significantly (greatly), compare to (put side by side), aviation (flying). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a report . It is about airplane crashes in 2018. There are 15 airliner accidents worldwide . 556 people die in them. In 2017, only 44 people die. 2017 is the safest year of flying ever. However, experts say that 2018 is not a terrible year. Experts say that flying gets safer and safer. Difficult words: report (an official document), airliner (a big plane like a Boeing or Airbus), worldwide (around the world, everywhere). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last Saturday, the Orthodox Church of Ukraine became independent. The church split from Russia after more than three centuries under its control. A decree of independence officially confirmed the split in Istanbul. The Russian Orthodox Church lost about a fifth of its nearly 150 million members. Due to recent tensions between Ukraine and Russia, the split became a political issue, as well. According to one British newspaper, Ukraine believes that Russia backed churches in Ukraine to spread propaganda and support anti-Ukrainian fighters. Difficult words: split (dividing), decree (an official document), due to (because of), back (support, help), spread (send to many places). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last Saturday, the Orthodox Church of Ukraine became independent from the Russian Orthodox Church. The Russian Orthodox Church lost a fifth of its nearly 150 million members. There are political problems between Russia and Ukraine, and the split of the churches became political, too. Difficult words: Orthodox (a type Christian Church which does not see the Pope as the ‘boss’), independent (free from), split noun (becoming two parts). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Some Christians are Orthodox . The Orthodox Church does not see the Pope as their leader. The Orthodox Church in Ukraine was part of the Russian Orthodox Church. Now this changes. The Ukrainian Orthodox Church is free from the Russian Church. There are some political problems between Ukraine and Russia. This situation is a political problem, too. Difficult words: Orthodox (a type Christian Church which does not see the Pope as the ‘boss’), church (not only the building but also the organisation of the religion), was (past of ‘ is’). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Chinese president announced plans of reunification of China and Taiwan. He thought Taiwan would operate like Hong Kong, and it would remain a democracy but under China. He added that any Taiwanese attempts to claim independence could be met with armed force by China. Regarding Hong Kong, the New York Times has reported that Hongkongers believe their freedom is gradually disappearing. The Taiwanese president said that she hopes that the international community is paying attention and it will speak out on behalf of Taiwan. Several US lawmakers want the US to support Taiwan. Difficult words: announce (officially say), reunification (becoming one country again), remain (stay), attempt (a try), claim (say that something is yours), regarding (about, when it comes to…), gradually (step by step). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Chinese president has a plan to reunite China and Taiwan. He said that China could use the army if Taiwan did not want to be part of China. The Taiwanese president said that she hopes that people in the world are watching what is happening. She hopes that other countries will support Taiwan. Difficult words: reunite (become one country again), support (say that you like something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Taiwan is a country and an island. It is east of China. China wants to be one country with Taiwan. The Chinese president says that the Chinese army can go to Taiwan if Taiwan does not want to be part of China. The Taiwanese president hopes that people in the world see this situation. She hopes that other countries can help Taiwan. Difficult words: army (the soldiers in a country), hope (wish that something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In September, the Indian Supreme Court stopped a rule that said that women of menstruating age (10 to 50 years old) could not enter temples . In the Hindu religion, women who menstruate are unclean and cannot be part of religious rituals. Some people said that the Supreme Court attacked Hinduism by changing this rule. Since the change of the rule, many women attempted to enter one important temple, but protesters blocked them. However, two 40-year old women entered the temple with two police officers who protected them. In one town, women created a 400-mile human wall to protest against discrimination . Difficult words: menstruate (a woman’s body has blood flow out of it each month if she does not get pregnant), temple (a church in India), discrimination (when people treat you differently if you are male or female). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In September, a court in India stopped a rule which said that women of menstruating age (10 to 50 years old) could not enter temples. In the Hindu religion, women who menstruate are not clean and they cannot be part of religious rituals . Some people said that the court attacked the religion when it changed this rule. After the change of the rule, many women tried to enter one big temple, but protesters blocked them. However, two 40-year old women entered the temple with two police officers who protected them. In one town, women made a 400-mile wall from their bodies. They protested against discrimination . Difficult words: court (a house where a judge is), menstruate (this happens each month when blood goes out of a woman’s body if she is not pregnant), religious ritual (a tradition which you do for a religion), enter (go inside), discrimination (when your situation is more difficult because you are a man or a woman). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In September, a court of India stops a rule . The rule says that some women cannot go in temples . They are 10 to 50 years old. In Hinduism, women who menstruate are not clean and they cannot go in temples. After the change of the rule, many women try to go in one big temple. Some people stop them. Then, two 40-year-old women go in the temple with the policemen. The policemen protect them. In one town, women make a wall from their bodies. The wall is 400 miles long. The wall is a protest. The women protest because they do not like discrimination . Difficult words: court (a house where a judge is), rule (what you must do), temple (a church in India), menstruate (when blood goes out of a woman’s body every month), discrimination (when your situation is more difficult because you are a man or a woman). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

By 2020, In Washington, the government of the USA hopes to reduce the number of drug -related deaths by half. Recently, according to a report, deaths increased more than three times, and African-Americans are more than 80 percent of those deaths. The government wants to focus on prevention, treatment and educating children. The plan may cost around $24 million and money will come from a federal grant . The government will implement this plan by September 2020. Difficult words: treatment (an activity which helps ill or injured people), grant (when the government gives money for a special thing). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Washington, the government of the USA wants to reduce the number of deaths which are caused by drugs. Recently , the number of deaths went up more than three times, and African-Americans are more than 80 percent of those deaths. The government wants to focus on prevention and educating children. The plan will cost $24 million and the money will come from the government. The plan will be implemented by September 2020. Difficult words: recently (not long ago), implement (make active). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The government of the USA wants to help people who use drugs. In Washington, many people die because they use drugs. The government has a plan to help these people. The government will give information to children about drugs. The government will help people who already use drugs. The plan can cost $24 million. The government wants to do this plan soon. Difficult words: government (the bosses of a country), cost (have a price). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Qatar has a new tax which some people call a ‘ sin tax’, and this tax took effect at the beginning of the year, and it was implemented on goods that may be harmful to human health and the environment. The extra money from the tax will go toward public services like schools, infrastructure and hospitals. Exact prices are not clear, but there is a 100 percent tax increase on alcohol, tobacco products, and energy drinks, as well as a 50 percent tax on soft drinks. However, the alcohol tax only affects foreigners living in Qatar, since they are the only people legally allowed to buy alcohol. Qatar is hosting the men’s football World Cup in 2022, and it is not yet clear how this new tax will affect foreigners who plan to visit. People suggested that alcohol could be served to visitors in special areas. Difficult words: sin (an action against religious rules), implement (apply), harmful (damaging, unhealthy), infrastructure (the basic physical and organizational structures and services needed for a city or a country), increase (rise, growth). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Qatar’s new tax took effect at the beginning of the year. People put it into practice on products which Qatar thinks are not good for people. The extra money from the tax will be used for public services like schools, infrastructure and hospitals. There is a 100 percent tax increase on alcohol, tobacco products, and energy drinks, as well as a 50 percent tax on soft drinks. However, the alcohol tax is only for foreigners because they are the only people who can buy alcohol in Qatar. Qatar is hosting the men’s football World Cup in 2022. The details are not known, but there might be special areas where visitors can have a drink. Difficult words: infrastructure (the way that services are created and managed in a country), increase (a moment when something goes up), host (to organize a sport event). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2019, Qatar’s new tax starts. It is an extra tax for some products. Qatar thinks that some of these products are not good for people. Alcohol, tobacco, energy drinks and soft drinks become more expensive. People in Qatar cannot buy alcohol. Only foreigners can buy alcohol. Qatar is the organizer of the men’s football World Cup in 2022. There can be special areas where visitors can drink alcohol. Difficult words: become (start something new), foreigner (a person from another country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

By 2025, Norway has a plan for all new cars to have zero emissions , and it is possible to achieve this goal. In 2018, almost one third of all new vehicles sold in Norway were already 100 percent electric. People reported it to be a world record for yearly vehicle sales. This shows a growing trend in Norway where electric vehicle sales were only 5.5 percent five years ago. Norway’s 2025 plan is very ambitious , but the government is trying to convince people to make the switch by offering a lot of incentives like free parking and not having to pay some taxes. Difficult words: zero emissions (making no gas into the air), ambitious (a new, interesting idea that may not happen), convince (tell somebody to do something and he or she does it), incentive (a thing that motivates someone to do something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Norway has a plan for 2025. It wants all new cars which people buy there to be electric. It looks like the plan is working. In 2018, the country set a world record for electric car sales when one third of all new cars were 100 percent electric. Five years ago, only 5.5 percent of new cars were electric. Norway’s 2025 plan is very ambitious , but the government offers help if you buy a new electric car. You can have free parking and you do not have to pay some taxes . Difficult words: set (make), sales (activity when you sell something), ambitious (a big idea that may not happen), tax (money which you pay to a government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This news is from Norway. It is about electric cars . In 2013, only 5.5% of new cars are electric. In 2018, it is 33%. This is a world record. People in Norway have a plan. They want to have all new cars be electric in 2025. This is a big plan. The government wants to help people buy electric cars. For example, if you buy an electric car in Norway, you do not have to pay for parking. Difficult words: electric car (a car which runs on electricity), government (the ‘bosses’ of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In August, Apple became the first ever American public company to reach a $1 trillion evaluation . However, Apple announced a reduced revenue outlook recently which came as a shock to the stock market . Apple’s CEO Tim Cook said that slow sales in China could cause the drop in value. After a lot of growth, experts say that China is facing an economic slowdown and 2018 is projected to have China’s slowest growth since 1990. With Chinese consumers more careful about how they spend their money, Apple is not the only company to face the consequences . Western car companies and Starbucks, for example, are finding it harder to sell in China. Other analysts blame the situation on Apple’s expensive pricing strategy. The frequency with which people upgrade their iPhones is lower, as well. Difficult words: evaluation (how valuable something is – how much money is in it), announce (to officially say to people), revenue outlook (how much money you think you are going to make), stock market (a market where people can buy stocks – parts of companies), CEO (a chief executive officer, the boss), consequences (the result, the situation which comes as a result of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In August, Apple became the first American company to be worth $1 trillion. Now, however, Apple said that it will make less money than before, and this is a shock to business people. Apple’s boss said that this is because people are buying fewer iPhones in China. After a lot of growth , China’s economy is slowing down . People say that 2018 will be the year of the slowest growth in China in the last 30 years. The Chinese are more careful with their money, so people buy less. For example, car companies and coffee companies also have fewer sales than before. Other experts say that Apple products are expensive. Apple’s boss also said that people do not upgrade their iPhones as often as they did in the past. Difficult words: growth (activity when something is getting bigger and bigger), slow down (be slower than before), upgrade (have a more modern or newer version). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Apple is a big American company. It is a computer company. It has a lot of money. In August, it has $1 trillion. However, business is smaller now. This news is a shock to business people. Apple’s boss says that the business is smaller because people in China do not buy many new iPhones. The Chinese economy is not growing as fast as before. Some people say that the business is smaller because Apple products are expensive . Difficult words: shock (a moment when you are very surprised), expensive (cost a lot of money). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
